body: Review request (independence rule): PR #1887 — BUG-1180 gate-aware CI watch (ADR-39). Implemented by the product/proxy seat; needs YOUR independent review + merge, I will not self-merge. Summary: new ci_gate module re-reads gh pr checks --json and classifies each red row: ignorable only if it is merge-hold-gate while the local hold marker exists, or a non-required check matching the [ci] informational allow-list (default workflow Cross-platform). Everything else red stays a failure. pr ship step 2 proceeds on hold/informational-only reds; step 3 waits for merge-hold-gate to re-run green after the label is removed, then merges. Drain CI phase applies the same refinement. Secondary call recorded on ADR-39: main's protection requires only merge-hold-gate (Build not required), so literal required-only was rejected. 4897 lib tests green, clippy correctness clean. Live probe: after you clear its hold, aida pr ship 1887 should go straight through. Also #1886 (BUG-1186) is CI-green and CLEAN, awaiting your review.
